text: 金十数据11月6日讯，据《泰晤士报》报道，伊朗正采取措施，为特朗普可能下令对其地下核设施实施核掩体穿透打击做准备，此前美国中期选举结果引发政治局势变化。当地网络流传的视频显示，伊朗政府对美国可能轰炸“镐山”设施深感担忧。据称，该设施内驻有高级科学家，位于纳坦兹铀浓缩设施以南约1英里处，其防护能力被认为足以抵御常规武器攻击。《泰晤士报》分析的视频似乎是在为当地居民应对针对该设施的核爆炸做准备。视频引导观众设想核爆炸发生的情景，并公布了距离周边主要城市的估算范围：纳坦兹17英里、卡尚25英里、伊斯法罕117英里、德黑兰223英里。随后，视频发布了明确的安全指
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 6 — According to The Times, Iran is taking measures to prepare for a possible nuclear bunker-buster strike on its underground nuclear facilities that Trump may order, after the U.S. midterm election results brought political changes. Videos circulating on local networks show the Iranian government is deeply concerned about a possible U.S. bombing of the "Pickaxe Mountain" facility. The facility is said to house senior scientists, is located about 1 mile south of the Natanz uranium enrichment facility, and is believed to be protected strongly enough to withstand conventional weapons attacks. The video analyzed by The Times appears to be preparing local residents for a nuclear explosion targeting the facility. The video guides viewers to imagine the scenario of a nuclear explosion and publishes estimated ranges for major surrounding cities: Natanz 17 miles, Kashan 25 miles, Isfahan 117 miles, Tehran 223 miles.
